studanky.title: Studánky
studanky.summary: Mobile app for iOS and Android (in development) that helps people monitor natural springs and plan trips with reliable access to fresh water.
studanky.details: Data collection runs through scanning QR codes placed at the springs and a short questionnaire, giving users fresh, first-hand insight into water quality and availability. Users can report damage directly to the spring's owner. The project welcomes partners and collaborators.

images.scanner: Studánky – QR code scanning at the spring

domov.title: Domov pod palcem
domov.summary: Mobile app for iOS and Android that controls an entire smart home. Designed for ergonomics and one-handed use – every control is reachable with the thumb of the hand holding the phone.
domov.details: The app configures itself for the signed-in user and talks to the home over a secured WebSocket protocol. It controls lights, blinds, gates, heating, floor heating, heat recovery and air conditioning – including schedules.

stable.title: Smart Stable
stable.summary: Mobile app for iOS and Android for managers of a smart cattle stable. It enables remote control of the stable equipment and raises alerts when technical issues or undesirable conditions appear.
stable.details: It adapts to the signed-in user and communicates over a secured WebSocket protocol. Managers control fans, tarpaulins and lighting, see live sensor readings and interactive 24-hour charts. Critical situations trigger automatic push notifications.

auth-flow.title: Flutter Auth Flow
auth-flow.summary: Open-source Flutter package with a configurable authentication UI that connects to any backend.
auth-flow.details: Login and sign-up, e-mail verification, password reset, CS/EN localisation. The code is public.

about.title: How we work
paragraphs: We are smolikja team and we craft every mobile app entirely in-house. We lead the full lifecycle – from strategy and product discovery through research, UX, visual design, technical architecture, implementation, marketing and launch – keeping quality, pace and context under one roof.

We run our own servers for development environments and combine them with cloud infrastructure in production, letting us scale safely, monitor and evolve the apps we deliver for clients and our own products.
